title: Buzz Words
description: A spelling game for kids. Hear the word, see the picture, and tap the honeycomb letters to spell it, with a friendly voice saying every letter. Earn stars and stickers and unlock buddies, gardens and tiles.
controls: Tap or click the letters in order. Tap the picture or 🔊 to hear the word again. Keyboard letters work too.
requirements: Any modern browser. Voice uses the browser's built-in speech. Saves progress in this browser.
